0022600026.text: The Hornets (3-5, 2-3 at home) have lost four straight and sit ninth in the East and third in the Southeast, 1.5 games back, while the Celtics (5-2, 4-0 at home) have dropped their most recent game and sit third in the East and second in the Atlantic, also 1.5 games back, in this Emirates NBA Cup East Group C matchup. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Charlotte lost 2-1 in the 2025-26 season series, including a 113-102 loss in Boston on April 7, 2026. Charlotte will be without Grant Williams (hamstring) and Kon Knueppel (leg soreness), and Boston will be without Devin Carter (illness) and Jayson Tatum (rest).
